captions.detailed: A light-grey passenger blimp featuring a streamlined, cigar-shaped main envelope, a long under-slung cabin, and a cruciform tail assembly with horizontal and vertical fins. On each side of the hull near the cabin, a dark-grey engine pod is mounted, holding a multi-bladed propeller. The left and right propellers rotate continuously on their local longitudinal axes, while the trailing edges of the horizontal and vertical tail fins act as control surfaces that pivot on simple revolute hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a passenger blimp with a streamlined main envelope, an under-slung cabin, a cruciform tail with movable control surfaces, and two side-mounted engine pods with rotating propellers. Use a light-grey material for the main envelope and cabin, and a dark-grey material for the propellers and engine pods, ensuring appropriate continuous and revolute articulations are defined.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp starting with the main hull envelope, modeled by lofting or revolving a streamlined profile, and joins a long under-slung cabin to its base. The cruciform tail fins are generated as extruded planar profiles and positioned at the rear of the envelope, with separate trailing-edge flaps attached via revolute joints. Cylindrical engine pods are modeled on each side of the hull, supporting propeller hubs and blades that are defined as separate parts connected via continuous rotational joints.
